text:
Type: floral wool area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, bohemian
Materials: hand-tufted wool, tasseled fringe
Colors: charcoal taupe field, beige, ivory, pale blue
Shape: rectangular, central medallion with scattered floral motifs, wide patterned border, chunky tassels on short ends
Feel: cozy, crafted, soft
Goes with: warm neutrals, natural wood, linen; farmhouse or traditional rooms

product.description: 80% Wool 20% Cotton Imported A subtle vintage pattern of floral motifs makes this rug ideal for transitional furniture settings.
